names.ice_cream_works_1605_indiana: 1605–1613 Indiana Avenue — the Thompson-Reid and Collins Bros. ice-cream works, building

source.citation: Real-estate column, Chicago Daily Tribune, 8 November 1903: the building news that Thompson-Reid and Collins Bros. 'have begun the construction of a four story building... and a barn, at 1605 to 1618 [1613] Indiana avenue'.
what_it_does_not_supply: how far the walls had risen by 1 July 1904
what_it_supplies: the plant's planned form: a four-storey brick building 100 by 177 feet, with a barn
its architect, A. R. Buckley, and its cost, $50,000
